newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish officials to probe attack on Kurd village.
newsitem.headline: Turkish officials to probe attack on Kurd village.

text.p: Turkish officials said on Thursday they were looking into accusations by Kurdish villagers that troops fired mortar bombs at their homes, killing one person and wounding three.
"Both legal and administrative investigations have begun into the incidents at Karsilar village," Efkan Ala, deputy governor of Tunceli province, told Reuters.
A 55-year-old woman, Esma Demir, died on Wednesday night when up to 15 mortars bombs rained down on Karsilar, residents said. They said troops in the nearby Geyiksuyu district fired the bombs.
The area is often the scene of fighting between soldiers and Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas fighting for Kurdish self-rule.
Ala said the government would compensate the villagers for the damage, which included the death of many livestock.
More than 26,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict in southeast Turkey and northern Iraq.
